people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

people.name: Hor_Mount
people.line: Mountain where Aaron died and was buried

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt
